newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian November inflation quickens to 1.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russian November inflation quickens to 1.9 pct.

text.p: Russian consumer prices rose by 1.9 percent in November after a 1.2 percent rise in October, the State Statistics Committee said on Wednesday.
Weekly inflation slowed in the short week ended November 29 to 0.3 percent from 0.4 percent in the previous week, it said.
Prices had risen by 20.1 percent in the first 11 months of the year, it said.
RUSSIAN CONSUMER PRICES w/e Nov 29 w/e Nov 25
If the current trend continues prices will rise by 22 percent in 1996, the committee said.
